Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_buffer VARCHAR2(10);
Begin
 temp_buffer := :s_customer_id;
 select name into :s_customer_name from customers
 where customer_id = temp_buffer
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and substr(customer_id,5,2)!='PA'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select customer_id, name into
 :s_customer_id, :s_customer_name
 from customers
 where customer_id = temp_buffer
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and substr(customer_id,5,2)!='PA'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 exception
 when no_data_found then
 begin
 select customer_id, name into
 :s_customer_id, :s_customer_name
 from customers
 where upper(name) like
 (temp_buffer || '%')
 and sysdate between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1)
 and substr(customer_id,5,2)!='PA'
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 exception
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_customer_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_customer_name := null;
 list_values;
 when no_data_found then
 show_error_dist('0302');
 check_package_failure;
 when others then null;
 end;
 when too_many_rows then
 :s_customer_id := temp_buffer;
 :s_customer_name := null;
 list_values;
 when others then null;
 end;
 when others then null;
end;
nullchk;
NEXT_ITEM;

ProgramUnit.Name: CREDIT_CUSTOMER
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure credit_customer is
 credit_ar_account VARCHAR2(20);
 shipment_no VARCHAR2(14);
 shipped_date Date;
 error_flag varchar2(1);
 attribute_found varchar2(1);
 usrtext2 varchar2(24);
 item_id varchar2(12);
 price_no varchar2(2);
 err_key VARCHAR2(70);
 patient_name varchar2(24);
 standard_price number(9,2);
 flag1 varchar2(1);
 today_date date;
 order_date date;
 temp_price number;
begin
 -- Get credit_ar_accout from customer table
 --
 begin
 select ar_account into credit_ar_account
 from customers
 where customer_id = :customer_dbcr_adjust.customer_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if :advice_id=:order_no then
 :GLOBAL.order_date:=to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-YY hh24:MI');
 else
 begin
 select to_char(insert_date,'MM-DD-YY hh24:mi') into
 :GLOBAL.order_date from orders
 where order_no=:order_no
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /* Modified by HCL CONSULTING */
 exception when no_data_found then
 :GLOBAL.order_date:=to_char(sysdate,'MM-DD-YY hh24:MI');
 when others then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 end if;
 begin
 select fi_company_no into :GLOBAL.fi_company
 from chapters
 where chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 :GLOBAL.fi_company := '1';
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 --
 -- Get Fi_Price_Sch_No
 --
 begin
 price_no := '00';
 end;
 --
 -- Get the shipment number
 --
 err_key := substr(shipment_no||'-'||:customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no||'-'||
 credit_ar_account,1,70);
/* Shipment number will be same as advice id and shipment date is todays date
 This was done to ensure that the advice id gets printed on the invoice from
 Libra*/
 shipment_no:=:advice_id;

 /* shipped_date:=
 to_char(to_date(:GLOBAL.today_date,'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI:SS'),'MM-DD-YY HH24:MI'); */

 patient_name := :s_patient_name;
 today_date:=to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.today_date, 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI:SS');
 shipped_date := today_date;
 order_date:=to_rrdate(:GLOBAL.order_date, 'MM-DD-RR HH24:MI');
 check_duplicate_order_no(:customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no,
 :Global.fi_company, today_date, flag1);
 if flag1 = 'N' -- new order, not duplicate
 then
 billing_interface.insert_header(:GLOBAL.fi_company,
 :customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no,
 credit_ar_account,
 shipment_no,
 shipped_date,
 order_date,
 today_date,
 error_flag);
 if error_flag = 'E'
 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 --
 billing_interface.insert_invoice_details
 (:GLOBAL.fi_company,
 :customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no,
 credit_ar_account,
 nvl(:service_code,:product_code),
 shipped_date,
 :amount,
 today_date,
 patient_name,
 usrtext2,
 :unit_id,
 price_no,
 'CREDIT ADJUSTMENT',
 -1*abs(nvl(:quantity,1)),-1*abs(nvl(:quantity,1)),
 'CR', :advice_id,
 error_flag);
 if error_flag = 'E'
 then
 message('Error in insert_invoice_details ');
 end if;
 --
 -- See if unit has any attribute
 --
end;

/* Shipment number will be same as advice id and shipment date is todays date
 This was done to ensure that the advice id gets printed on the invoice from
 Libra*/

 if flag1 = 'N' -- new order, not duplicate

 billing_interface.insert_header(:GLOBAL.fi_company,

 shipped_date,

 if error_flag = 'E'

 end if;
 --

 (:GLOBAL.fi_company,
 :customer_dbcr_adjust.order_no,

 shipped_date,
 :amount,

 :unit_id,
 price_no,
 'Debit ADJUSTMENT',
 abs(nvl(:quantity,1)),abs(nvl(:quantity,1)),'DB',
